nodes.name: bot-reply-route.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test suite for the GET /bot-reply API route, covering authentication guards, thread status checks, job queueing, fresh/stale job handling, and inline fallback processing.

nodes.name: bot-reply.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive unit test suite for `processBotThreadReply`, verifying required-field validation, RAG chunk filtering, LLM call behaviour, DB side effects, cache revalidation, and return value shape.

nodes.name: env.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for all environment helper functions in `lib/env.ts`, verifying presence/absence detection for database, R2, Groq, Copilot, and the active LLM provider, plus `assertEnv` behaviour.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin-only server component page that renders the LLM model switcher, loading runtime config and masked secrets then passing them to `ModelSwitcherForm`.

nodes.name: AdminModelSwitcherPage
nodes.summary: Async Next.js server component that guards the route with `requireAdmin`, fetches LLM config and masked secrets, and renders the card-wrapped model switcher form.

nodes.name: transcript.ts
nodes.summary: Server actions for generating structured knowledge-transfer documents from meeting transcripts using Groq LLM, and pushing the generated content to the project knowledge base as a processed document.

nodes.name: generateDocumentFromTranscriptAction
nodes.summary: Server action that accepts a transcript text or file uploads, extracts content, calls Groq LLM to generate a structured KT document, and returns the formatted output in markdown, text, or DOCX format.

nodes.name: pushToKnowledgeBaseAction
nodes.summary: Server action that uploads generated content to storage, inserts a document record, enqueues a document_process job, and optionally links the document to a discussion thread.

nodes.name: buildDocxBuffer
nodes.summary: Converts a markdown string into a fully-styled DOCX buffer using the `docx` library, handling headings, bullet lists, numbered lists, and inline bold formatting.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Background job worker API route that claims and dispatches Postgres-backed jobs for document processing, quiz generation, bot thread replies, and connector syncs, with error logging and stale-job recovery.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: HTTP POST handler that authenticates the worker secret, resets stale running jobs, conditionally triggers connector auto-sync, atomically claims the next pending job, and dispatches it to the appropriate processor.

nodes.name: processQuizGenerateJob
nodes.summary: Fetches document chunks for a project, shuffles them into sets, generates quiz questions via LLM for each set with exponential backoff, and inserts quiz sets and questions into the database.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: API route that polls or enqueues bot reply generation for a discussion thread, with an inline fallback that processes the reply directly if the worker job has been pending for over 30 seconds.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Auth-guarded GET handler that returns an existing bot reply, enqueues a new job if none exists, or falls back to inline processing for jobs stale beyond 30 seconds with atomic claim to prevent duplicate work.

nodes.name: model-switcher-form.tsx
nodes.summary: Client-side React form component for the admin model switcher, rendering provider-specific credential and model fields for all seven supported LLM providers with live provider selection and smooth scroll.

nodes.name: ModelSwitcherForm
nodes.summary: Exported React component that renders a provider-selection dropdown and conditionally displays credential/model input sections for each of the seven LLM providers, submitting via a server action.

nodes.name: bot-reply.ts
nodes.summary: Core service that generates AI bot replies for document discussion threads by retrieving relevant RAG chunks, calling the LLM with a system prompt, and persisting the answer with sources to the database.

nodes.name: processBotThreadReply
nodes.summary: Validates params, retrieves RAG chunks, calls LLM for an answer (or uses no-match fallback), inserts a bot comment with deduplicated sources, and triggers Next.js cache revalidation.

nodes.name: ensureBotFailureReply
nodes.summary: Idempotently inserts a failure-notification bot comment into a thread only if no bot comment already exists, then updates the thread's updated_at timestamp.

nodes.name: connectors.ts
nodes.summary: Document connector sync engine supporting Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, Monday.com, OneDrive, and GitHub with demo-fixture mode, upserting synced documents and triggering RAG processing for each provider.

nodes.name: syncDocumentConnector
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a full sync for a given connector by loading its record, setting status to running, dispatching to the provider-specific sync function, and updating status to success or failed.

nodes.name: enqueueDueDocumentConnectorSyncJobs
nodes.summary: Atomically enqueues `connector_sync` jobs for all active connectors with auto-sync enabled whose last sync time exceeds the specified interval, skipping any that already have a pending or running job.

nodes.name: parse.ts
nodes.summary: Text extraction utility supporting PDF (pdf-parse), DOCX (mammoth), CSV (csv-parse), XLSX, and PPTX file formats, returning plain text from any supported binary document.

nodes.name: extractTextFromFile
nodes.summary: Dispatches file content extraction to the appropriate library based on file extension, returning plain UTF-8 text from PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, PPTX, or raw buffer.

nodes.name: pii.ts
nodes.summary: PII redaction utility that scans text for emails, phone numbers, SSNs, and credit card numbers using regex patterns, replacing matches with [REDACTED] and reporting counts and types found.

nodes.name: redactPii
nodes.summary: Applies all PII regex patterns to the input text sequentially, replacing matches with [REDACTED] and returning the cleaned text along with the match count and type list.

nodes.name: process.ts
nodes.summary: Document ingestion pipeline that redacts PII, scans for secrets, chunks the content, embeds each chunk, persists chunks with embedding metadata, and updates the document record with scan results.

nodes.name: processDocumentRecord
nodes.summary: Full document ingestion pipeline: redacts PII, scans for sensitive content, chunks text, generates embeddings in parallel, persists all chunks, updates the document record, and logs PII detection activity.

nodes.name: scan.ts
nodes.summary: Document sensitivity classifier that scans text for secrets (AWS keys, API keys, passwords, connection strings) and internal-use markers, returning a classification of confidential, internal, or public.

nodes.name: scanDocument
nodes.summary: Applies secret and internal-use regex patterns to classify a document as confidential, internal, or public, also incorporating whether PII was previously detected.

nodes.name: upload.ts
nodes.summary: Thin server-only wrapper that generates a UUID-based filename for an uploaded `File` object and delegates to `uploadFile` in local storage, returning the storage path.

nodes.name: uploadDocumentToStorage
nodes.summary: Generates a project-scoped UUID filename and uploads a File's buffer to local storage, returning the stored path.

nodes.name: env.ts
nodes.summary: Central environment configuration module exposing a typed `appEnv` object with all runtime env vars and helper functions to check whether each LLM provider, database, and storage provider is configured.
nodes.languageNotes: Exposes a mutable `appEnv` object to allow test-time overrides, which is why env.test.ts can reassign fields and restore them with afterEach.

nodes.name: chat.ts
nodes.summary: Groq-specific LLM client with retry logic and model fallback, exposing `createGroqChatCompletion` for chat traffic and `createGroqQuizCompletion` (quiz-optimised, uses separate API key if set).

nodes.name: createGroqChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Creates a Groq chat completion with automatic primary-to-fallback model switching and up to 3 retry attempts with rate-limit-aware back-off.

nodes.name: createGroqQuizCompletion
nodes.summary: Quiz-specific Groq completion function using the quiz API key (falls back to chat key) and starting with the smaller instant model to reduce rate-limit contention with chat traffic.

nodes.name: anthropic.ts
nodes.summary: Anthropic Claude LLM provider implementation using raw HTTP fetch with system-message extraction, request timeout, and retry logic; normalises the response to the unified chat completion shape.

nodes.name: createAnthropicChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Calls the Anthropic Messages API with split system/user messages, 120-second timeout, and up to 3 retries with rate-limit back-off, normalising the text-block response to the unified format.

nodes.name: copilot.ts
nodes.summary: GitHub Copilot proxy LLM provider with retry/back-off logic, normalising the OpenAI-compatible response to the unified shape, plus a generator-based streaming placeholder.

nodes.name: createCopilotChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Posts to the Copilot proxy endpoint with the configured token and model, retrying on rate limits with 60-second back-off, and normalising multi-type content blocks to a plain string.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Unified LLM provider abstraction that routes `createChatCompletion` and `createQuizCompletion` calls to the runtime-configured provider (Groq, Copilot, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, or Ollama).

nodes.name: createChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Provider-agnostic chat completion entry point that reads runtime config, checks credential availability, and delegates to the appropriate provider implementation.

nodes.name: createQuizCompletion
nodes.summary: Quiz-generation variant of `createChatCompletion` that routes to the quiz-optimised Groq client for the groq provider, and falls back to standard completion for all other providers.

nodes.name: openai.ts
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible HTTP client implementing `createOpenAiChatCompletion`, `createOllamaChatCompletion`, and `createAzureOpenAiChatCompletion` with shared retry logic and response normalisation.

nodes.name: createOpenAiChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Sends a JSON chat completion request to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with optional Bearer auth, retry on failures, and normalises the response to the unified shape.

nodes.name: createOllamaChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Calls a local Ollama `/api/chat` endpoint in non-streaming mode, mapping Ollama's response shape to the unified completion format.

nodes.name: createAzureOpenAiChatCompletion
nodes.summary: Builds the Azure OpenAI deployment URL with API version, posts with `api-key` auth, and normalises the response to the unified completion shape.

nodes.name: runtime-config.ts
nodes.summary: LLM runtime configuration service that reads provider, model, and credentials from the `app_settings` table (DB-first) with fallback to environment defaults, and exposes masked secrets for admin display.

nodes.name: getLlmRuntimeConfig
nodes.summary: Reads LLM provider and model config from the `app_settings.llm_config` row, normalising all fields and falling back to environment defaults on miss or error.

nodes.name: getLlmRuntimeSecrets
nodes.summary: Reads provider API keys and endpoints from the `app_settings.llm_secrets` row, normalising and falling back to environment defaults.

nodes.name: getMaskedLlmRuntimeSecrets
nodes.summary: Returns a masked copy of all LLM secrets suitable for admin UI display, replacing key values with asterisked previews.

nodes.name: observability.ts
nodes.summary: Application error logging utility that inserts structured error events into the `app_error_events` table with source, category, message, stack, and metadata, silently swallowing any logging failure.

nodes.name: logApplicationError
nodes.summary: Inserts a truncated error event into `app_error_events` with source, category, message, stack, and JSON metadata; any insertion failure is swallowed to avoid breaking the caller.

nodes.name: chunking.ts
nodes.summary: Simple token-based text chunking utility that splits normalised whitespace-tokenised text into overlapping chunks of configurable size for RAG ingestion.

nodes.name: chunkDocumentText
nodes.summary: Splits input text into overlapping word-token chunks using a sliding window with configurable size (default 500) and overlap (default 50).

nodes.name: embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: Local embedding service using `@xenova/transformers` (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 by default) with lazy singleton initialisation, mean-pooled normalised 384-dimensional vectors.

nodes.name: embedText
nodes.summary: Returns a 384-dimensional float embedding vector for the input string, initialising the feature extractor singleton on first call.

nodes.name: retrieval.ts
nodes.summary: RAG retrieval service that asserts embedding model consistency across a project's chunks before embedding the query and executing cosine-similarity search via the `match_document_chunks` Postgres function.

nodes.name: retrieveRelevantChunks
nodes.summary: Asserts embedding consistency, embeds the query, and retrieves the top-N most similar document chunks from the project using the Postgres vector similarity function.

nodes.name: local.ts
nodes.summary: Local filesystem storage provider with path-traversal-safe resolution, providing upload, download, streaming, delete, and stat operations for documents stored in `public/uploads/`.

nodes.name: uploadFile
nodes.summary: Writes a buffer to the upload directory under a timestamp-prefixed sanitised filename and returns the relative `uploads/<filename>` path for DB storage.

nodes.name: downloadFile
nodes.summary: Resolves the stored path safely to prevent directory traversal and reads the file buffer from disk.
